rv.q: But there are excitement, curiosity and a fierce hope of salvation in it as well.
Pablo Schreiber brings raw sexual magnetism and simmering volatility to his role as Eben, while Carla Gugino makes a persuasive Abbie, her earthy sensuality masking steely calculation.
What we get instead is a production that feels more like a high school staging of O'Neill than a Broadway revival worthy of the material's stature.
